title: Justifiably Juicy Malaysian Tofu Curry
description: Savory and comforting Malaysian dish featuring crispy double-fry tofu in a rich and creamy curry sauce, made with soda water for added depth of flavor.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Double-fry the tofu by frying it until golden brown, then letting it cool and frying it again until crispy.
In a separate pan, mix the curry powder and garam masala and heat over low heat for 1 minute.
Add the soda water to the spice mixture and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the coconut milk and stir to combine.
Add the double-fry tofu to the curry sauce and simmer for 10 minutes.
Mix the potato starch with a small amount of water to make a slurry, then add it to the curry sauce and stir to combine.
Season the curry with salt to taste.
Serve the curry hot over rice or noodles.
